description: This file contains a PHP trait named SessionConnectionConfigTrait used for configuring AWS DynamoDB session storage, including settings for table name, key attributes, session lifetime, locking, and associated getters and setters.

methods.name: initConfig
methods.description: Initializes configuration from an array, setting properties via corresponding setter methods, and defaults session lifetime if not specified.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the DynamoDB table used for sessions.

methods.name: setTableName
methods.description: Sets the name of the DynamoDB table used for sessions.

methods.name: getHashKey
methods.description: Returns the hash key attribute name.

methods.name: setHashKey
methods.description: Sets the hash key attribute name.

methods.name: getDataAttribute
methods.description: Returns the data attribute name in the table.

methods.name: setDataAttribute
methods.description: Sets the data attribute name in the table.

methods.name: getDataAttributeType
methods.description: Returns the data attribute type.

methods.name: setDataAttributeType
methods.description: Sets the data attribute type.

methods.name: getSessionLifetime
methods.description: Returns the session lifetime value.

methods.name: setSessionLifetime
methods.description: Sets the session lifetime value.

methods.name: getSessionLifetimeAttribute
methods.description: Returns the name of the session lifetime attribute.

methods.name: setSessionLifetimeAttribute
methods.description: Sets the name of the session lifetime attribute.

methods.name: isConsistentRead
methods.description: Indicates whether consistent reads are used.

methods.name: setConsistentRead
methods.description: Sets whether to use consistent reads.

methods.name: getBatchConfig
methods.description: Returns batch configuration options.

methods.name: setBatchConfig
methods.description: Sets batch configuration options.

methods.name: isLocking
methods.description: Indicates whether session locking is enabled.

methods.name: setLocking
methods.description: Enables or disables session locking.

methods.name: getMaxLockWaitTime
methods.description: Returns maximum wait time (s) for lock acquisition.

methods.name: setMaxLockWaitTime
methods.description: Sets maximum wait time (s) for lock acquisition.

methods.name: getMinLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Returns minimum microsecond wait between lock retries.

methods.name: setMinLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Sets minimum microsecond wait between lock retries.

methods.name: getMaxLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Returns maximum microsecond wait between lock retries.

methods.name: setMaxLockRetryMicrotime
methods.description: Sets maximum microsecond wait between lock retries.
